Package services

Class ReadabilityService

java.lang.Object
services.ReadabilityService
public final class ReadabilityService extends Object
Estimates English readability from cached plain text without any external calls.

AI assistance: implementation support for Phase 8 formulas and text heuristics.

Author:
Nabeel Ali
